sections.name: isModuleLoadError, retryDelays, sleep
sections.title: Recognizing download errors and wait times
sections.what: Decides whether an error is a download problem, and sets the wait times between retries.
sections.why: Only download problems are retried, so real bugs show up immediately.
sections.watch_out: Matching is based on message text, which can change between browsers.

sections.name: loadModuleWithRetry
sections.title: Retry loop for page loads
sections.what: Tries to load a page, waits and retries on download errors up to the set limit, and throws any other error at once.
sections.why: Recovers from brief network or deploy problems without hiding real bugs.
sections.watch_out: The loop stops after the last wait, so a permanent failure eventually reaches the error boundary.

sections.name: lazyPage
sections.title: Lazy page wrapper
sections.what: Wraps a page loader so the app loads that page only when it is first shown, using the retry loop.
sections.why: The comment says import calls stay visible to the build tool, and a failure shows a reload option instead of losing work.
sections.watch_out: The page loader must keep its import call inside the wrapper, or the build tool cannot split the code.

summary: Loads page code on demand and retries it when the download fails for a temporary reason.
purpose: Makes large pages load faster and recovers when a page file fails to download.
why: The comment says a cached or replaced file can fail to load. The app offers a reload rather than discarding the user's work.
how: Wraps the normal page loader with a retry routine. Only download-type errors trigger retries, with waits of 750, 1500, and 3000 milliseconds. Other errors are passed straight through.
inputs: A function that loads a page module.
outputs: A lazily loaded page component that the router can display.
risks: Browsers word their download errors differently, so a new browser message may not be recognized as a download error.
debug: If a page fails to load, check the browser console for the error text and confirm it is on the recognized list. Test with a network interruption.
